summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that its insiders deposited the sixth monthly extension contribution of US$125,000 into the trust account on August 26, 2026, pursuant to a previously approved charter amendment allowing monthly extensions up to March 23, 2027. This is a routine SPAC extension update, not a new special situation event. The filing confirms ongoing compliance with extension terms and increased per-share redemption value. Watch for future extension deposits or business combination announcements; no deal terms or advisors disclosed.
